intro: The modern world is quite demanding. We must be present every second. Monitoring the news, and not forgetting about our own health. In this constant flow, we attempt to find that elusive work-life balance. And it is easy to lose ourselves. That is why a wellness retreat can be essential for this. Our experts have analysed various options and found the best wellness retreats in the US. Each of them specialises in specific areas of relaxation and helps with different types of recovery, both physical and mental. We will also look at the price of such retreats and their availability. Today we will discover the top 10 places for your recovery and how to choose the option that is right for you.
highlights: The best US wellness retreats blend nature, proper nutrition, recovery therapies and mindfullnes practices.
Many retreats offer personalized plans with certified experts and doctors.
Prices vary widely, from simple community stays to luxury desert resorts.
Clear goals and the right format make your retreat truly effective.

blocks.text: Top 10 Wellness Retreats

Here we searched for the best options of wellness retreats in the US. In this digest, you will definitely find something for yourself, from a single mindful resort to a couple of retreats. These hotels focus on more intensive programmes and physical activity, while others are concerned with your diet.
Tailor-Made Wellness Retreat
Both retreats belong to the Aman network and offer individually tailored wellness programmes. Here you have several options:

items: Tailor-Made Wellness Retreat at Amangiri. Located in the heart of the Utah desert, it is rightly considered one of the most impressive wellness retreats in the United States. The entire style echoes the local landscape. So be prepared to see a lot of terracotta shades. Through [breathing practices](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/breathwork-biohacking), heat rituals and mindful movement you will recognise your inner self. The programme includes mineral massages, evening meditations and individually tailored meals. If the spa is not enough for you, you can always add hiking or horse riding.

Tailor-Made Wellness Retreat at The Lodge at Blue Sky. We move from desert landscapes to the dynamic mountains of Utah with snow and a cooler climate. A personalized program helps you to make the experience purely unique. This health and wellness retreat is known for its [cryotherapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-cryotherapy), experimental [yoga practices](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohackers-guide-to-yoga) and [sound therapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/sound-therapy-in-biohacking). You can also go skiing here. Fishing and clay are also available.

blocks.text: **Location** : Canyon Point, Utah / Wanship, Utah
**Prices** : from $1,800 per day
**Focus** : personalised recovery, mindfulness, yoga, thermotherapy
The Lodge at Woodloch

This chateau in Pennsylvania allows you to escape from everyday life. Immerse yourself in the quiet mountain retreat with a peaceful atmosphere of snow-covered nature. The spa area, stone therapy, several types of saunas and a cryotherapy room are also added for your release. It is located among forests and lakes, where every element contributes to restoring balance. The hotel offers more than 35 activities daily. You will find yoga and Pilates, and you can also try art therapy and swimming in a mineral pool.[The concept of Nature Nurtures](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-019-44097-3#Sec2)is essential here. Which means to restore harmony through contact with nature.

Every morning begins with breathing exercises, and in the evening you have [mindful meditation](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-meditation) to lock the day. You will have seasonal vegetables and farm-fresh products. The recovery plan could be created individually under the guidance of nutritionists and trainers. Spacious rooms with forest views help you disconnect from the outside world and listen to your inner voice.
**Location** : Hawley, Pennsylvania
**Prices** : from $700 per night
**Focus** : recovery, stress relief, nature mindfulness
Kripalu Centre for Yoga & Health

If you are a yoga fan, this retreat is designed for you! Kripalu Centre will reveal new facets of your body and mind. This place helps to focus on yourself and recover from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The focus here is on self-discovery. Which is why the hotel’s design is quite minimalistic. Programs include hatha yoga, pranayama and meditation classes. Everything here concentrates on emotional recovery.
Besides the actual yoga retreat, you can learn. Wellness resort offers several training programmes. So if you want to turn your favourite activity into your main job here are some options:
Each day begins with silent meditation and ends with lectures on mindfulness and nutrition. The food focuses on vegetarian cuisine with an emphasis on whole foods.
**Location** : Stockbridge, Massachusetts
**Prices** : from $250 per day
**Focus** : yoga, spiritual renewal, mindfulness
Canyon Ranch

This place combines medicine, sports, psychology and mindfulness. You receive consultations with nutritionists, trainers and sleep recovery specialists. The programme includes strength and aerobic training, spa therapies, [massages](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/massage-therapy) and lectures on hormonal balance. This is a place where everything is dedicated to the science of longevity. An important bit is that Canyon Ranch employs doctors, certified nutritionists, and fitness coaches. They create individualised programmes for your goals. Spacious spa areas, thermal rituals and outdoor yoga create an atmosphere of inner stability.

Special attention is paid to nutrition. In creating the menu were involved nutritionists and biochemists so you can be sure of what you eat. Most options are sugar-free but still tasty! The Sonoran Desert gives you an atmosphere of a lost universe so concentration on your inner self happens unconsciously. creating the perfect conditions for a digital detox and complete focus on yourself.

Another resort from Canyon Ranch is based in Lenox, Massachusetts. It has quite different vibes as first of all Massachusetts is quite a cold state, so be ready for snow. The Berkshire Mountains are known for their gentle, balanced approach to recovery. The atmosphere is cosy and informal, so making new contacts is also simple. The resort also offers anti-ageing programmes that rejuvenate you both inside and out. These include yoga, swimming and breathing sessions. The seminars on [mindful eating](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-guide-to-mindful-eating) and [stress management](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-for-stress-management-what-about-mental-health) help you to get something new into your daily routine after the retreat ends.
**Location** : Tucson, Arizona / Lenox, Massachusetts
**Prices** : from $1,500 per day
**Focus** : medicine and wellness, physical activity, anti-ageing
Mii amo

Mii Amo is located in Sedona. This region is known for its powerful energy and red rocks. Programmes include breathing practices, energy therapies and sound healing. Each session is individual and aimed at relieving inner tension. The space is filled with light, essential oil aromas and soft music. The atmosphere here is more reminiscent of a temple than a hotel.

Meals are prepared with organic produce from local farmers, and the menu is tailored to the needs of each guest. Arizona clay baths, rock meditations, and crystal therapy help to rejuvenate the body and mind. It is the ideal place for those seeking more than relaxation. It’s more about inner transformation. Mii Amo regularly ranks among the world’s top wellness centres according to [Condé Nast Traveller.](https://www.anandaspa.com/uploads/documents/GeneralDocuments/Condenast-Nov%2719.pdf)
**Location** : Sedona, Arizona
**Prices** : from $1,900 per night
**Focus** : spiritual restoration, sound healing, energy therapy
Miraval Resorts

blocks.alt: Inclusive Offers, Specials & Packages | Miraval Arizona Resort

blocks.text: This chain of premium luxury wellness retreats is located in several different states, offering a wider choice. At the same time, the price of each resort remains roughly the same regardless of location.

items: Tucson, Arizona. One of the most famous wellness resorts in the United States. One of the first steps of this wellness retreat is turning off your phone. It creates a complete sense of being alone with the desert that has been in this area for centuries. Dive into the breathing techniques, yoga and ayurvedic spa treatments. One of these retreat specials is equine therapy. It is a meditation with horses which helps you to fix some trust issues and grow emotional intelligence. The main principle of the retreat is Live in Balance. Which shows how you can combine different parts of your life without losing yourself. The spa offers treatments using local plants and essential oils from the Sonoran Desert.

Berkshires, Massachusetts. This option is suitable for those seeking a home retreat in snowy Massachusetts with its dense Berkshire forests and quiet, slow-paced life. Guests can choose between action-packed programmes and quiet days for reflection and walks. The food is organic, with a focus on restoring hormonal and energy balance.

Austin, Texas. Miraval Austin is located in the Texas hills, overlooking Lake Travis. The resort combines wellness and outdoor activities: hiking, paddle yoga, breathing practices and spa therapy. You can also receive nutritional advice and a personalised fitness programme. The atmosphere is kept informal so that you don’t have to experience any unnecessary stress. In the evenings, there are group meditations and lectures on stress management. Everything is aimed at relaxing your soul and immersing yourself in your inner processes.

blocks.text: **Location** : Tucson, Arizona / Berkshires, Massachusetts / Austin, Texas
**Prices** : from $1,200 per day
**Focus** : mindfulness, digital detox, emotional well-being
The Ranch

You won’t get bored on this retreat! Whether it’s scattered cottages in the mountains of Malibu in warm California or a stone mansion in Hudson Valley in New York, you will be able to completely reboot your body and mind. You can expect early mornings, long hikes in the mountains, and strength training. These activities will be combined with yoga and stretching.

This type of retreat is more physical than spiritual, just keep it in mind. The programmes are built around the principle of complete purification. Talking about the food it is worth noting that all the menu here is vegan and sugar-free. Even with such a strict schedule you will have time to relax, so don’t be scared too much. If you need to lose some weight these retreats could also be useful. After this week your sleep patterns could normalise as well and cortisol levels get in balance.

The Art of Living Retreat Centre

blocks.alt: The Art of Living Retreat Centre

blocks.text: If you are interested in a spiritual retreat, try The Art of Living Retreat Centre. Based on the philosophy of Sri Sri Ravi Shankar, it offers programmes aimed at cleansing the mind and body. [Sudarshan Kriya](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38294813/) is the main practice. This breathing technique has proven effective in reducing anxiety levels. Also, you can attend yoga classes, Ayurvedic spa treatments, and seminars on emotional stability.

The atmosphere here is warm and friendly. The accommodation is comfortable and minimalist. Programmes are tailored to guests’ goals. So if you need relaxation, mental recovery or working with inner barriers just put it as a priority. The centre is ideal for those who want to learn how to work with their breath and attention without religious undertones.
**Location** : Boone, North Carolina
**Prices** : from $350 per day
**Focus** : breathing practices, meditation, mental recovery
Omega Institute for Holistic Studies

Omega Institute is for those who seek personal development through practice and awareness. The centre combines a wellness approach with education: it hosts lectures, yoga sessions, and master classes on creativity and emotional recovery. Among the teachers, you will find world leaders in the field of self-development, including Deepak Chopra and Eckhart Tolle. The atmosphere at this wellness resort is intimate, yet inspiring and cosy. You will find yourself surrounded by a garden and a massive lake.

Guests can choose an intensive format with a daily schedule or a gentle programme with plenty of free time. An important part of the retreat is feeling part of the community and learning to communicate with those around you without using gadgets. This place is ideal for a gentle introduction to the world of wellness and spiritual practices.
**Location** : Rhinebeck, New York
**Prices** : from $200 per day
**Focus** : mindfulness, creativity, self-development
Kalani Oceanside Retreat

If you are in love with the ocean this is your choice! A tropical wellness paradise where nature comes alive and becomes part of the therapy. Located on the coast of Hawaii, it offers unique[ocean therapy](https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/book-review-blue-mind-on-the-benefits-of-being-near-water-by-wallace-j-nichols/2014/08/08/a504c932-02c7-11e4-8fd0-3a663dfa68ac_story.html), yoga and dance movement programmes. The morning begins with practices on the beach, breathing exercises that are adjusted to the sound of the ocean. Special daily rituals help you let go of excess stress and return to yourself.

Kalani is not like a luxury resort. It has a rather modest design and is focused on spiritual growth. The retreat offers a vegetarian menu, and the atmosphere is kept friendly and as simple as possible. Guests can participate in[art therapy](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5004743/), capoeira classes, or simply relax in a hammock under the palm trees. This is a place where people come for freedom, creative energy, and deep restoration.
**Location** : Big Island, Hawaii
**Prices** : from $500 per day
**Focus** : yoga,[dance](http://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31481910/), ocean therapy
How to Choose the Best Wellness Retreats

As you can see, there are many different types of retreats, ranging from more active options focused on physical endurance to lighter ones aimed at developing emotional intelligence and self-awareness. To ensure that your experience is enjoyable and exactly what you want it to be, let’s understand how to choose the right retreat for you.
1. Define Your Goal
Before looking for a suitable retreat centre, ask yourself: what is your ideal retreat? It could be for physical recovery, reducing anxiety, emotional rebooting, spiritual practice or bodywork.
2. Consider the Duration and Intensity

If you are going for the first time, do not choose a programme that is too long. Stay for 3-4 days, which will be enough for your first reset. Those who are more advanced in retreats and are not going for the first time should consider longer programmes, for example, 7-10 days.
3. Check the Approach and Philosophy of the Retreat

It is important to understand what a particular programme is aimed at so that you don’t get bored or, conversely, find it too intense. It is also better to understand in advance what kind of menu awaits you, as a completely vegetarian diet, for example, may not be to everyone’s cup of tea.
4. Pay Attention to Specialists and Certification
Do a little fact-checking. Look at the specialist you are going to trust with your health and make sure they have all the certificates needed.
5. Check What is Included in the Price
Sometimes meals, treatments and transfers are charged separately. Check in advance to avoid unexpected costs and understand the real price of the programme.
6. Read Reviews About the Place

Even the most popular retreat may not be right for you if it doesn’t suit your pace. Read reviews about the place you plan to go to and understand how comfortable you are with the intensity that this resort offers.
Summary

In this article, we have reviewed the best wellness retreats in the USA. We discovered the desert oases of Amangiri and the forest mindfulness centres of Miraval and Canyon Ranch. They are all united by one idea: recovery begins when a person consciously returns to themselves. We have shown how to choose the right destination and what parameters to consider when planning a trip.
To get the most out of all inclusive wellness retreat, follow these simple tips:

items: Define your personal goal, whether physical, emotional or spiritual.
Try also a couples retreat. It will help you to know your partner better. And maybe even make some friends with other couples!
Start with a short programme if this is your first experience.
Choose a format that matches your activity level.
Pay attention to the team of specialists and the quality of the infrastructure.
Don’t compare yourself to others; a retreat only works when you focus on your own process.
Continue to maintain the habits you’ve developed at home, and the effect will quickly fade.
And most importantly, choose a place where you can breathe easily.
